text:
alex.m: Quick sync — we need to pick a strategy for the next DP cohort. Do we prioritize recruitment velocity (more partners, lighter integrations) or feedback depth (fewer partners, deep instrumentation + weekly interviews)?

tara_p: we only have engineering bandwidth for 4 deep integrations over 6 weeks. velocity would let us onboard ~12 with a lightweight flow.

miguel: +1. Also consider QA cost: deep integrations blow up our test matrix.

jamie: what are our success criteria for this cohort? retention, usage, integration completeness?

alex.m: proposed success metrics: 1) 75% partner retention through week 4, 2) 3 actionable product improvements flagged with repro steps, 3) average response time to partner issues < 24h.

sasha: can we do a hybrid? e.g., 8 partners: 4 deep (full SDK + monitoring), 4 light (API keys + short checklist).

miguel: hybrid seems sensible. ops-wise we can template the light flow and reserve SRE/debug slots for deep ones.

jamie: incentive plan idea: tiered stipend + priority support credits for deep partners. keeps them motivated for bigger asks.

alex.m: logistics: we need an onboarding checklist and a minimal eval harness from partners. Draft acceptance criteria for deep vs light:

pm-bot: New doc created: https://notion.redwood/dp-cohort/brief (auto-link)

alex.m: Acceptance (deep): 1) customer can call our API end-to-end with sample prompt set, 2) logs available (structured errors + latency) to our S3 onboarding bucket, 3) weekly 30m sync with PM/Eng, 4) signed NDA if PII.

alex.m: Acceptance (light): 1) can call hosted API with their example prompts, 2) completes a 10-min survey on UX/latency, 3) shares 1–2 crash repros if seen.

tara_p: timeline: recruiting open Thu, close in 10 days, kickoff two weeks after close. Agree?

miguel: agree but cap deep slots at 4. If >4 deep applicants, we run a short strawpoll + product fit scoring (use rubric).

jamie: small ask — can we require a short video (3–5 min) of integration walkthrough for deep partners? speeds review.

sasha: yes, and we can provide a short template video we recorded so they know what's expected.

alex.m: feedback loop plan: weekly written pulse + 1 deep interview at week 3, automated eval metrics collected daily (latency p50/p95, error rate, token spend).

alex.m: also adding launch gates: Gate A = integration stability for 2 weeks + >= 70% completion of partner feedback tasks. Gate B = no critical regressions in eval harness for last 5 days.

tara_p: who owns runbooks for partner escalations? propose eng-oncall handles infra, pm owns product prioritization of partner bugs.

miguel: agreed. Add runbook link and ensure oncall rota has a DP flag.

jamie: measurement: set up a small dashboard in Console: per-partner latency/cost, feature adoption, and NPS after week 4.

alex.m: action items: 1) tara draft outreach copy + form (due in 48h), 2) miguel build templated light-flow checklist + S3 bucket (48h), 3) jamie define stipend tiers + video template (72h), 4) sasha record onboarding exemplar (72h).

pm-bot: Reminder set for 48h: DP cohort artifacts due.

sasha: will take onboarding exemplar. adding a short checklist for privacy-safe demo data.

alex.m: final Q — do we want to accept partners that need private deployment (VPC/on-prem) in this cohort? my vote: exclude, too much ops variance.

miguel: exclude for now. we can run a separate private DP track later.

tara_p: ok excluding private for now. I'll add that to the outreach copy.

jamie: ok — sounds like hybrid cohort, 8 total, 4 deep / 4 light, exclude private. proceeding with recruitment window Thu + 10 days.

alex.m: thanks all — will spin up the Notion brief + invite list.

pm-bot: Thread closed (autoclose after 14d of inactivity).
